en: Black‑and‑white view of a large church with a tall, steep spire and a square tower standing on an open cobblestoned square lined with trees and low townhouses. People in early‑20th‑century clothing, including children, walk across the square; a horse‑drawn vehicle is visible in the background. The church has a massive brick tower with tall belfry openings and a decorative gabled clock stage near the top, attached to an older, lower nave with smaller Gothic-style windows. A few classic streetlamps and a kiosk or small pavilion stand near the church. The scene suggests a quiet European town center.
